short_title: Cabinet Hardware 3-Inch Cabinet Pull | Allied Brass, Polished Nickel
description:
Upgrade your bathroom cabinetry with solid brass cabinet hardware designed to add a distinctive finishing touch in Polished Nickel, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces. This 3-inch cabinet pull brings a balanced transitional look that pairs contemporary lines with traditional elements, helping you coordinate drawers and cabinet doors with matching pieces across a cabinet hardware collection.

Highlights:
- Polished Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Cabinet-mount installation with all mounting hardware included
- Designer finishes help coordinate with versatile bath accessories
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Type: Cabinet pull
- Material: Brass
- Style: Traditional
- Mounting type: Cabinet mount
- Dimensions: 3.9-inch L x 1.6-inch H x 0.9-inch W
- Projection: 1-inch
- Weight: 0.8 lb
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Cabinet pull and all installation hardware
